biggest_catch: The $25 is a simple per-person finder's fee, but the referred member must be 100% new (no re-opened or previous members), and you cannot be a joint owner on their account or live in the same household.
catches: Referral must be qualified: new members must be 100% new - re-opened accounts, current joint members, and previous members are not eligible.
Referring member cannot be a joint owner on the new account or in the same household as the new member.
Accounts must be in good standing at the deposit date; new membership accounts qualified through monthly reports and verification.
New member is separately eligible for a $25 Cha-Ching Reward after opening checking + eStatements + $50+ direct deposit within 30 days.
Field of membership: Harris County employees/families and listed Houston zip codes.
No referral-count cap stated on the page.

steps: As an existing HCFCU member, fill out the member referral form with your friend's information.
Friend joins Harris County FCU as a 100% new member (different household, not a joint account with you).
You earn $25 for each qualified person you refer.
timing: Finder's fee paid after the new membership is qualified through monthly reports and verification; accounts must be in good standing at deposit.
when_cash_arrives: Finder's fee paid after the new membership is qualified through monthly reports and verification; accounts must be in good standing at deposit. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
